prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
No kind of change has proven helpful yet, as no test resulted in a statistically significant win.
Sign-in reordering (sign_in, reorder) tends to have a negative impact, as 2 tests agree after noise correction (-2.3% overall).
Adding new finish screens (finish, new_screen) tends to have a negative impact, as 3 tests agree after noise correction (-3.4% overall).
New adoption flows (adoption, new_flow) tend to have a negative impact, as 2 tests agree after noise correction (-1.7% overall).
Adoption redesigns (adoption, redesign) and path selection redesigns (choose_path, redesign) showed no clear effect across 2 tests each.
Evidence is still thin for home flows (home, new_flow) with only 1 test, and predictions were consistently overly optimistic across most tests.

Measured so far, by kind of change (relative change on the target step):
- adoption, new_flow: -1.7% after noise correction, 2 test(s)
- adoption, redesign: +1.3% after noise correction, 2 test(s)
- choose_path, redesign: +0.1% after noise correction, 2 test(s)
- finish, new_screen: -3.4% after noise correction, 3 test(s)
- home, new_flow: +2.5% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- sign_in, reorder: -2.3% after noise correction, 2 test(s)

Funnel:
- choose_path: 76.2%, median 8s / mean 514s
- sign_in: 72.9%, median 3s / mean 567s
- adoption: 60.9%, median 89s / mean 1017s
- home: 81.3%, median 201s / mean 2336s
- finish: 64.8%, median 395s / mean 5815s
- finishing onboarding overall: 17.8%

Return JSON {"scores": [{"index": i, "impact": n, "evidence": n, "confidence": n, "cost": n,
"predicted_lift": x, "note": short}]}

Changes:
0: [sign_in, hint] Sign In Pet Restoration Notice Copy: Display an explicit hint on the sign-in screen informing users that signing into an existing account automatically restores their previous pets. (why: Support received 8 emails regarding pets missing or reset after signing in, indicating user confusion during account login.)
1: [choose_path, redesign] Path Selection Grid Layout Redesign: Redesign the path selection screen into a clean grid view displaying companion adoption paths side by side. (why: The choose_path step has a 76.2% conversion rate and a high mean completion time of 514s, showing users spend significant time evaluating path options.)
2: [home, wait_info] Waiting Screen Desktop Readiness Hint: Add an estimated setup duration and desktop status indicator to the waiting screen while pet files finish processing. (why: Home waiting step has a median time of 201s and mean of 2336s, while 3 support tickets reported pets not appearing or apps stalling during setup.)
3: [adoption, redesign] Pick Friend Full Bleed Gallery Redesign: Redesign the pick_friend screen using a full-bleed visual layout to showcase available starter pets vividly. (why: Adoption has the lowest funnel conversion rate at 60.9% and a long mean completion time of 1017s.)
4: [finish, hint] Home Intro Desktop Controls Hint: Add desktop interaction tip text to the home intro screen explaining how to access companion controls from the system tray. (why: Support received 3 emails from users confused about how to control, hide, or talk to their pet after setup.)
5: [choose_path, new_screen] Onboarding Story Companion Preview Screen: Insert a new introductory screen before path selection that introduces key desktop pet features and interactions. (why: Initial path selection loses 23.8% of users with an 8s median and 514s mean time, showing users need clearer upfront context.)
6: [adoption, hint] Photo Upload Lighting Guidance Hint: Provide clear photo tip text on the upload screen advising well-lit photos for optimal pet generation. (why: 3 support tickets reported custom pet generation failures or unexpected visual results.)
7: [sign_in, redesign] Sign In Screen Split Layout Redesign: Rebuild the sign-in screen using a split layout to separate new account creation from returning user pet sync. (why: Sign-in conversion is 72.9% with a 567s mean time, and 8 support emails reported lost pets due to signing in with wrong accounts.)
8: [home, new_flow] Waiting Screen Interactive Tip Carousel Flow: Introduce an interactive tip carousel flow on the waiting screen with automatically rotating tips on desktop pet usage. (why: Users spend a median of 201s (mean 2336s) on the waiting screen, leading to boredom or early dropoff.)
9: [finish, incentive] Home Intro Completion Welcome Incentive Copy: Update the final onboarding headline and body to celebrate completing adoption and unlocking companion features. (why: Overall onboarding finish rate is only 17.8%, with 64.8% converting on the final step.)
